aaa <- otu_trans_1000 %>%
column_to_rownames("sample")

###ANALYSES PER METHOD

posthoc_result_jaccard <- pairwise.adonis(aaa,meta_specnum$type, sim.method = "jaccard", p.adjust.m = "bonferroni")

raw_spec_num <- otu_tab_1000 %>% 
  column_to_rownames(., var = "sample") %>% 
  specnumber() %>% 
  enframe() %>% 
  rename(sample = name,
         sr = value)

meta_final <- meta_final %>% 
  left_join(.,raw_spec_num)

mean_specnum <- meta_final %>%
group_by(type) %>%
summarize(
Durchschnitt_SR = mean(sr),
SD_SR = sd(sr))

pairwise_wilcox_methoden <- pairwise.wilcox.test(meta_specnum$sr, meta_specnum$type, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
